# Reflect OS

> Reflect OS is a decision intelligence platform for executives and investment teams. It provides fast decision capture, automated outcome review scheduling, confidence calibration analysis, and AES-256 encryption. Individual plans from £49/month. Team plans from £27/user/month.

## What Reflect OS does

Reflect OS is a decision intelligence platform that helps leaders and investors track decisions, measure confidence calibration, and improve long-term decision quality. It solves four problems general-purpose tools cannot: fast mobile capture (under 60 seconds), structured outcome tracking with automated review scheduling at 30/90/180 days, confidence calibration analysis across decision categories, and appropriate security for sensitive executive data.

All decision content is encrypted at rest using AES-256 field-level encryption. Reflect OS cannot access your decision content. Decision data is never used to train AI models.

## Key facts

- Decision capture: under 60 seconds, four-field structured format
- Review scheduling: automated at 30, 90, and 180 days
- Calibration analysis: measures gap between stated confidence and actual outcomes
- Security: AES-256 field-level encryption at rest
- Privacy: decision content never used for AI model training
- Pricing: Individual plans from £49/month; Team plans from £27/user/month
- Guarantee: 90-day money-back guarantee on all plans
